criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Literary Works
categories.definition: Written works such as novels, short stories, poetry collections, and graphic novels.

categories.name: Plants
categories.definition: Members of the biological kingdom Plantae, including trees, flowers, shrubs, and herbs.

categories.name: Mountains
categories.definition: Landforms that rise prominently above their surroundings, including mountains, hills, and mountain ranges.

categories.name: Companies
categories.definition: Business entities, organizations, or brands involved in commercial, industrial, or professional activities.

categories.name: Lakes
categories.definition: Inland bodies of standing water, including lakes, ponds, and reservoirs.

categories.name: People
categories.definition: Individual human beings, including politicians, artists, athletes, and other public figures.

categories.name: Buildings
categories.definition: Man-made structures with roofs and walls, such as houses, skyscrapers, and historic sites.

categories.name: Films
categories.definition: Motion pictures, including feature films, documentaries, and television movies.

categories.name: Albums
categories.definition: Collections of audio recordings, including studio albums, soundtracks, and compilations.

categories.name: Villages
categories.definition: Small human settlements located in rural areas, smaller than a town.

categories.name: Ships
categories.definition: Vessels that travel on water, including naval ships, ferries, and historical ships.

categories.name: Animals
categories.definition: Members of the biological kingdom Animalia, including mammals, birds, fish, insects, and mollusks.

categories.name: Rivers
categories.definition: Natural flowing watercourses, including rivers, streams, and tributaries.

categories.name: Educational Institutions
categories.definition: Institutions dedicated to education, including schools, universities, and colleges.

categories.name: Aircraft
categories.definition: Vehicles capable of atmospheric flight, including airplanes and helicopters.

categories.name: Trains
categories.definition: Rail transport vehicles, including locomotives, train sets, and railway carriages.

categories.name: Automobiles
categories.definition: Road vehicles, primarily cars, designed for passenger transport.

categories.name: Journals
categories.definition: Periodical academic or professional publications.

categories.name: Museums
categories.definition: Institutions that care for and display collections of objects of artistic, historical, or scientific value.

categories.name: Hospitals
categories.definition: Health care institutions providing patient treatment with specialized medical and nursing staff.

categories.name: Religious Buildings
categories.definition: Structures used for religious worship, such as churches, mosques, and temples.

categories.name: Islands
categories.definition: Land masses surrounded by water.

categories.name: Comics
categories.definition: Publications consisting of comic art in the form of sequential panels.

categories.name: Craters
categories.definition: Circular depressions on the surface of a planet or moon, typically caused by impact or volcanic activity.
